snippet.title: Eclipse Breaker – Gameplay & Story Reveal Trailer | Parry-Focused Action Roguelike
snippet.description:
Play the demo & wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815060/Eclipse_Breaker/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=evergreen&utm_content=trailer

Master the parry. Bring back the Sun Save the world.

Eclipse Breaker is a fast-paced, parry-focused roguelike with 90s-inspired visuals and modern combat depth. Face relentless enemies, adapt to new challenges, and defy extinction itself.

Features:
– Parry-based combat that rewards skill and timing
– Procedurally generated runs with endless replayability
– Bosses, challenges, and secrets to discover
– New demo coming to Steam Next Fest October 2025

Release Window: 2025 

Follow us for updates: https://linktr.ee/lunarworkshop
